summary: The AI sent a lone 3-model unit on a 4-turn trip into the enemy deployment zone. It rejected the near objectives that scored 25 to 31, and the chosen option scored -2.4.
better_option: Advance obj_home_1 (advancing to arrive a turn sooner — worth ~1 VP)

summary: The AI sent a fragile 4-model Prosecutor Squad 29.8 in toward the enemy home objective. The AI itself says it needs 7 more OC after this unit. It rejected obj_center and obj_nml_1, which score 33.36 and 31.19 and are worth about 7 VP each.
better_option: Advance obj_center (advancing for extra range — worth ~7 VP)

summary: The AI sends the Allarus on a 28% charge at Blade Champion Beta. A miss leaves the Allarus deep in enemy territory with no gain. The score depends on ch_damage, ch_can_wipe and order_round_aggression, and does not weigh the miss case.
better_option: unlisted: do not charge. Hold or shoot with the Allarus, and move them toward an objective next turn.

summary: The AI sent the grenade launcher at Gamma and the spears at Beta. This splits fire between two units, and neither is likely to die.
better_option: Balistus Grenade Launcher → enemy Custodian Guard Sodality Beta (P1)

summary: The AI shot Delta, which is not contesting the home objective, instead of Allarus Custodians, which is. Both shots deal about 1.8 damage and kill nothing.
better_option: Guardian Spear – Ranged → enemy Allarus Custodians (P2)

summary: Beta declares a charge at a 28% chance against 18-wound Allarus. The AI's own ch_retaliation of -10 is nearly as large as its ch_damage of 15. The positive score comes from unscaled terms, not a clear gain.
better_option: unlisted: do not charge, and keep Beta back to shoot or screen

summary: The AI declared a 17% charge at a 9.1 in target. The score is positive only because ch_damage of +20.0 outweighs ch_chance of -11.25 and ch_retaliation of -10.0. A failed charge wastes the unit's turn.
better_option: unlisted: do not charge, and keep the unit near obj_center
